FULL TEXT:
DEPARTMENT OF SANSKRIT
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH- 160014 (INDIA)
Ref. No. D-SKT/23/686 Dated 21/12/2023
NOTICE FOR “EARN WHILE ONE LEARNS SCHEME”
(For Students and Research Scholars)
Fresh applications are invited from Students/Research Scholars of Panjab University’s Teaching
Departments under “Earn While One Learns Scheme” in the Department of Sanskrit, Panjab
University for digitization of department library.
Essential requirement : The applicant must have Knowledge of Hindi/Sanskrit typing.
Number of
students required
Work Assignment Total Hours Honorarium per
student
Two (02) Multipurpose
library work
(Data Entry of
books detail etc.)
80 hours work from 02 students
for one month required on
extendable basis till the
completion of work wef date of
assigning the work
Rs. 100/- per hour
subject to ceiling of 40
hours per month i.e.
Rs. 4000/-
The applicant shall have to give an undertaking that he/she is not availing any kind of
fellowship/scholarship. The candidates who are already availing financial assistance under “Earn
while one Learns Scheme” are not entitled to apply again.
The applicants are required to fill the application form attached herewith and submit the application
form duly filled in alongwith the copy of ID card of the respective department to the Chairperson,
Deptt. of Sanskrit, Panjab University, Chandigarh in hard copy format latest by 10th January, 2024
till 4.00 pm. After screening of the applications, selected candidates will be informed accordingly.
(Prof. V.K. Alankar)
Academic Incharge
Issued to :-
1. Director, Computer Centre with request to circulate the said notice to all the Heads of
Teaching Departments of Panjab University and the same may be displayed on the notice
board of the departments respectively
2. Notice Board of Deptt. of Sanskrit, PU, Chandigarh
